description: [$x402 pay-per-call] Resolves DNS records for a hostname (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA).

type.description: Record type: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, or SOA. Default: A.

x_payment.description: Optional. Signed x402 payment header (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT) from the caller. If omitted, returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements.

name: net_tools_dns_lookup
